chunks.title: Civic Services Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Civic Services Platform | Section: Overview | Category: project]
Municipal road maintenance often suffers from fragmented reporting channels (untracked phone calls, WhatsApp messages, paper grievances), leading to delayed repairs, duplicate submissions, zero citizen transparency, and poor administrative accountability.

The **Civic Services Platform** provides a structured, verifiable lifecycle management system for public infrastructure repairs.

chunks.title: Civic Services Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Civic Services Platform | Section: System Workflow & Perspectives | Category: project]
1. **Citizen Portal (Reporter)**:
   - Captures road defects on mobile with geo-tagged photographic evidence, automatic GPS coordinate tagging, and descriptive notes.
   - Provides real-time status tracking (`Submitted` → `Assigned` → `In Progress` → `Resolved` → `Closed`).
2. **Municipal Admin Dashboard (Triage & Dispatch)**:
   - Aggregates incoming reports onto an interactive GIS map.
   - Detects duplicate complaints within configurable spatial radiuses.
   - Dispatches work orders directly to designated field engineers with SLA deadlines.
3. **Field Engineer / Crew View**:
   - Receives prioritized work tickets with location navigation.
   - Updates status to `In Progress` upon site arrival and uploads verified after-repair photo proof to transition to `Resolved`.
4. **Citizen Verification & Closure**:
   - The reporting citizen inspects the resolution evidence, approves the work or requests re-inspection, and leaves rating feedback.

chunks.title: Civic Services Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Civic Services Platform | Section: Key Features & Architecture | Category: project]
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Distinct authorization boundaries for Citizens, Municipal Officials, and Field Technicians.
- **Deduplication Engine**: Geospatial proximity clustering prevents multiple submissions for the same pothole from creating redundant dispatch tickets.
- **Evidence Verification**: Mandatory photographic before-and-after proof ensures transparent audit trails.

chunks.title: RedactVision Agent
chunks.content:
[Document: RedactVision Agent | Section: RedactVision Agent | Category: project]

> **Client / Organization**: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)  
> **Team**: ByteForce | **Category**: Software & AI Systems

chunks.title: RedactVision Agent
chunks.content:
[Document: RedactVision Agent | Section: Problem | Category: project]
Traditional cloud-based browser automation and autonomous web agents transmit complete DOM snapshots, screenshots, and page text to remote LLM servers. This routinely leaks sensitive Personal Identifiable Information (PII)—including login credentials, session tokens, financial records, medical details, and contact information—across third-party network boundaries.

chunks.title: RedactVision Agent
chunks.content:
[Document: RedactVision Agent | Section: Architecture & Solution | Category: project]
RedactVision Agent enforces a strict **zero-leakage privacy boundary** directly inside the user's browser:

1. **Local DOM Extraction**: Browser content script extracts the active DOM and visual metadata on-device.
2. **Local Privacy Firewall**: On-device algorithms identify and tokenize sensitive entities into anonymous semantic placeholders (e.g., `[EMAIL_01]`, `[PERSON_01]`, `[PHONE_01]`).
3. **Sanitized Remote Reasoning**: Only sanitized, anonymous tokens and safe structural metadata are transmitted to the server reasoning engine (FastAPI `/llm/plan`).
4. **Structured Action Planning**: The server LLM reasons over anonymous tokens and returns structured JSON actions (`click`, `type`, `scroll`, `wait`, `navigate`).
5. **Local Validation & Token De-anonymization**: The browser extension validates action safety, maps synthetic tokens back to real local values on-device, and executes the action natively in the page. Raw PII never crosses the wire.

chunks.title: RedactVision Agent
chunks.content:
[Document: RedactVision Agent | Section: Tech Stack | Category: project]
- **Frontend / Extension**: TypeScript, Manifest V3 Browser Extension, Vanilla DOM APIs
- **Backend Service**: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic
- **AI & Reasoning**: Groq Llama 3 / LLM Function Calling, Structured JSON output schemas
- **Privacy & Security**: On-device regex & heuristic entity tokenizers, strict action allowlisting

chunks.title: RedactVision Agent
chunks.content:
[Document: RedactVision Agent | Section: Key Features & Highlights | Category: project]
- **Zero Raw PII Exposure**: Sanitizes DOM on-device before any external network request.
- **Bi-directional Token Mapping**: Reconstructs localized input actions on the client without exposing credentials.
- **Resilient Action Executor**: Safe execution pipeline prevents malicious prompt injections from triggering unauthorized browser behaviors.
- **Built for ISRO Specification**: Designed specifically for mission-critical, high-compliance enterprise environments.

chunks.title: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform | Section: Overview | Category: project]
At the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre, researchers investigate ischemic stroke pathology by analyzing human brain tissue at microscopic and whole-organ scales. Correlating high-resolution post-mortem histology tissue sections with pre-mortem MRI scans is critical for understanding cellular damage and tissue recovery.

chunks.title: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform | Section: The Challenge | Category: project]
Neuroscientists required an intuitive, zero-latency tool capable of handling ultra-large resolution histology imagery alongside 3D MRI cross-sections, allowing fine-grained spatial registration, rigid/affine coordinate alignment, and precise anatomical stroke boundary annotations.

chunks.title: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform
chunks.content:
[Document: Stroke2D — Histology & MRI Neuroimaging Platform | Section: Implementation & Contribution | Category: project]
- **Stroke2D Interactive Visualizer**: Engineered an interactive browser module in Vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas to load, pan, zoom, and cross-reference histological slices with corresponding MRI planes.
- **Image Alignment & Registration Workflows**: Built algorithms and visual handles for scientists to manually and semi-automatically align anatomical landmarks between staining modalities.
- **Stroke Lesion Annotation**: Designed vector annotation tools enabling researchers to demarcate infarcted regions, compute area/volume metrics, and save vector boundary masks directly to PostgreSQL.
- **OpenAtlas Platform Modernization**: Contributed full-stack feature enhancements, REST API endpoints in Django, and UI components in Angular for the centre's flagship OpenAtlas Editor platform.
